ui-sync-fixes-343-v2.js: async function loadStatCountsOnce(){if(statLoaded)return;statLoaded=true;try{const j=await window.BALL46_STATISTICS_DATA.load();paintStatCounts(j.rows,j.total)}catch(err){statLoaded=false;document.querySelectorAll('[data-stat-market] b').forEach(b=>b.textContent='—');console.warn('Statistics menu count preload failed',err)}}
dashboard-v2-stage3.js: async function loadScorebarSettlements(){if(document.visibilityState==='hidden')return;try{const j=await window.BALL46_STATISTICS_DATA.load();settledSignalRows=j.rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>Number(b?.settledAt||b?.createdAt||0)-Number(a?.settledAt||a?.createdAt||0));renderWorkspaceScorebar()}catch(err){console.warn('Scorebar settlements refresh failed; keeping last-good settlement state',err)}}
